summary.headline: SPML Infra Q1 FY27 revenue rose 74% YoY to INR286 crore and PAT 87% to INR22.7 crore, with EBITDA margin at 10%.
summary.overview:
Q1 FY27 revenue grew 74% YoY to INR286 crore, EBITDA rose 81% to INR28 crore and PAT rose 87% to INR22.7 crore, with EBITDA margin at 10% versus 9% a year earlier. Revenue was flat QoQ, EBITDA rose 17% QoQ, and PAT fell 20% QoQ because Q4 FY26 included a one-time tax reversal. Management reiterated FY27 guidance of more than 25% growth in turnover, EBITDA and PAT, with new-order contribution expected mainly from Q4. The company also highlighted a BESS manufacturing line (2.5 GW, targeting NTPC supply from Q4), a stronger balance sheet, and credit rating upgrades.</overview>

segments.name: Water
segments.commentary: Drinking water, irrigation, river linking and sewerage; pipeline of about 134 projects worth INR98,725 crore across 11 states, with irrigation and water supply over 80% of value. Water projects take 3 to 3.5 years to execute.

segments.name: Power substation (power EPC)
segments.commentary: Management cites strong demand from thermal capacity additions and substation modernisation; execution of 15 to 18 months per project. Specific Q1 revenue not disclosed.

segments.name: BESS (battery energy storage)
segments.commentary: Expected FY27 BESS execution of INR200 to 300 crore, mainly in Q4 subject to NTPC design and container approvals. 2.5 GW assembly line is ready; expansion to 5 GW and 600 container units per year targeted for 1H FY28.

guidance_outlook: FY27 turnover, EBITDA and PAT growth guided at more than 25% YoY, maintained; to be updated each quarter based on orders and execution.
FY27 order inflow target of more than INR5,000 crore; INR1,293 crore won in Q1 and L1 in INR212 crore.
BESS execution of INR200 to 300 crore in FY27, subject to NTPC approvals; design approvals expected by December and container supply from Q4.
Legacy order book of about INR1,251 crore expected to be executed in FY27 and FY28.
Management says new orders will carry EBITDA margin above 10%; company does not take orders below 10%.
Remaining NARCL payment expected to be about INR300 crore after completion of arbitration-linked repayments this fiscal.
capex_capacity: BESS 2.5 GW assembly line at Supa MIDC, Pune, fully ready; IEC/UL certifications in progress for battery packs.
Expansion from 2.5 GW to 5 GW plus container capacity of 600 units per year targeted for 1H FY28; already started per management.
Total BESS capex of INR236 crore, described as fully funded through equity, a INR10 crore container term loan (sanctioned) and bank LC/working capital limits.
25 acres of land acquired; management says land is sufficient for future growth beyond the current capacity.
Management says 5 GW to be fully utilised by 2029 or 2030; expansion beyond 5 GW to be considered later, not yet discussed at Board level.
demand_pricing: Management says the BESS market requirement is 208 GW by 2030, versus 34.72 GW in FY27; tenders are coming continuously.
Management says it does not take orders below 10% margin; the three recent orders (Konar, Kekri, Indore) are above 10%.
Price variation (PV) clauses are required in all contracts under SPML 2.0; steel, currency and lithium cost risk is passed through.
Company says it bids monthly on tenders above INR10,000 crore in aggregate, with Gujarat as preferred state.
Competition: management cites the exclusive Energy Vault technology tie-up and NTPC provenance pre-qualification as differentiators; C&I off-grid BESS under evaluation.

qa_highlights.question: Is the INR3,843 crore new order figure net of JV partner share?
qa_highlights.answer: No, it is SPML's share only, including JVs held at 26%, 49% and 51%.

qa_highlights.question: Will margins move toward 12% as new orders come in?
qa_highlights.answer: Management says all orders are targeted above 10% EBITDA margin; no 12% target was given.

qa_highlights.question: How much BESS revenue in FY27 and when?
qa_highlights.answer: INR200 to 300 crore, expected in Q4 subject to NTPC design and container approvals by December.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the INR50 to 80 crore FY26 spillover has been billed?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it will be spread quarterly over the year, linked to government cash-flow timing; no Q1 billed amount given.

qa_highlights.question: What is the main constraint to achieving more than 25% growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited no specific constraint beyond unforeseeable events; design approvals are in hand for new orders, and NTPC approval is pending.

qa_highlights.question: What is the BESS revenue per GW?
qa_highlights.answer: Management indicated INR2,000 to 2,500 crore for 2.5 GW and INR4,500 to 5,000 crore for 5 GW.

qa_highlights.question: Status of NARCL repayment?
qa_highlights.answer: Total liability INR700 crore including interest; INR325 crore paid, including INR45 crore prepayment; balance INR375 crore tied to a INR678 crore arbitration award; about INR300 crore to be left after this fiscal year.

risks_watch: NTPC design, drawing and sample container approvals (targeted by December) are a gating item for the FY27 BESS revenue of INR200 to 300 crore.
Revenue flat QoQ at INR286 crore; the >25% growth guidance depends on order conversion mainly from Q4.
Legacy order book (about INR1,251 crore) and ongoing NARCL and arbitration recoveries; around 40% of INR4,526 crore claims are expected to convert to awards.
Working capital is managed through an escrow mechanism in water; cash of about INR150 crore as on 30 June.
Imported cells from China and FX exposure; management says these are covered by PV clauses, but timing of pass-through is unclear.
Management did not give specific margin guidance beyond 10%, and FY27 order inflow of more than INR5,000 crore is an ambition, not a confirmed book.
summary.management_tone: Confident on guidance and BESS ramp, but vague on specifics: management repeatedly deferred to 'we will update every quarter' and gave no billing or margin numbers for Q1 spillover or FY27 margin. Most detail was about NTPC approvals and order-flow ambition.
key_quotes: So if everything goes right, then we can expect 200 crores to 300 crores of BESS order execution into this financial year.
As we explained into our previous con-call that as a strategy, at this moment, we don't take any order less than 10%.
